confusions: Which capability records progress? stage.progress.update carries only {unit_id, stage_id, status}. It can move status but can't hold 'finished the stride example, C 5/8'. The text has to go through stage.note.write, which the docs call a 'compatibility capability only' for existing stage scratch files, or through `los observe` (learner evidence), which needs a requirement id. resume says 'Requirement none authored for this stage'.

Which channel and approval kind an agent should use: WORKFLOWS §8 says an agent-origin envelope claiming direct-user-gesture fails closed; stage.note.write declares no admission, so I used channel operator + operator-approval.
expected_revisions must cover 'exactly every artifact the transaction touches'. Nothing documents which artifacts stage.note.write touches (study map? unit? both?).
How to compute approval.subject_sha256: the docs only say intent_sha256(envelope). Which fields are hashed and how they are serialised is not documented, and the error message doesn't say.
